description:
WHAT: Return sanitized copies of texts with every local PII/secret finding replaced (placeholder [EMAIL_1], mask, or salted hash).
WHEN: Right before sending user data to an LLM/third party. Use returnPlaceholderMap=true if you need to restore originals in the LLM answer later.
WHEN NOT: For a findings report only use pii_scan_text. For names/addresses NER, URLs or PDFs use pii_guard_documents (paid).
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One "redacted_document" row per text with output_text; meta.placeholder_map only when requested. Errors: INPUT_TOO_LARGE.
BEHAVIOR: Same input gives the same output except redactionStyle "hash" (random per-call salt). No network calls; local, milliseconds.
PARAMETERS: texts: one element per document, 500,000 chars in total; the same value gets the same placeholder in every document of one call ([EMAIL_1] everywhere), but numbering restarts on each call. redactionStyle: "placeholder" is the only reversible style; "mask" keeps a few characters for human review; "hash" output differs between calls (random salt), so do not compare hashes across calls. returnPlaceholderMap: only has an effect with redactionStyle="placeholder" (ignored for mask/hash); the map in meta.placeholder_map holds the ORIGINAL values, so keep it out of the LLM prompt and restore answers with pii_restore_text (free, local). entityTypes / allowList / entropyScan / defaultPhoneRegion: identical semantics to pii_scan_text (filter after detection, whole-value case-insensitive allow-list). limit/offset page whole documents (one item per text, default 10 per page), not findings.
EXAMPLE: {"texts":["Call +1 415 555 0100 or mail jane@acme.com"]} -> output_text "Call [PHONE_1] or mail [EMAIL_1]".

allowList.description: Optional, default [] (nothing exempt). 0-500 exact values (<= 500 chars each) that are never flagged; whole-value, case-insensitive match, not substring. Example: ["support@yourco.com","192.0.2.1"]

defaultPhoneRegion.description: Optional, default "US". ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (2 letters, pattern ^[A-Za-z]{2}$, case-insensitive) used only for phone numbers written without a +country prefix. Examples: "US", "DE", "GB"

entityTypes.description: Optional, default omitted = every local detector. 0-40 detector type names (<= 40 chars, case-insensitive), e.g. ["EMAIL","CREDIT_CARD","AWS_ACCESS_KEY"]. Valid values: the "type" field of pii_list_detectors rows with local:true; unknown names match nothing (no error)

entropyScan.description: Optional boolean, default false. true also flags unlabeled random-looking tokens of 20-200 chars as HIGH_ENTROPY_STRING (catches unknown key formats; may flag hashes/UUIDs). Example: true

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-50 (default 10). Example: 10

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

redactionStyle.description: Optional, one of "placeholder" | "mask" | "hash", default "placeholder". "placeholder" = [EMAIL_1] (reversible); "mask" = j***@a***.com, **** **** **** 1111; "hash" = [EMAIL:3f2a9c0d1b7e] (salted sha256 prefix, random per-call salt). Example: "mask"

returnPlaceholderMap.description: Optional boolean, default false. true (placeholder style only) adds meta.placeholder_map {"[EMAIL_1]":"jane@acme.com"} containing the ORIGINAL sensitive values. Example: true

texts.description: Required. 1-50 documents (prompt, chat message, log, file content), each <= 200,000 chars, total <= 500,000 chars. Example: ["Mail jane@acme.com, key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"]

name: pii_redact_text

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Redact PII and secrets locally (free)
